report:
Pancreas and duodenum, head of pancreas, pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple resection)

Received in formalin is a pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple resection) specimen measuring 150 x 90 x 60 mm. The pancreatic head measures 55 x 45 x 35 mm, the attached duodenum measures 160 mm in length and the common bile duct measures 35 mm in length. The pancreatic neck, bile duct, uncinate (superior mesenteric artery) and posterior surfaces are inked in different colours and the neck and bile duct margins are taken en face. There is a firm, ill-defined pale tumour centred on the head of pancreas measuring 14 x 12 x 8 mm. The pancreatic duct is dilated to 6 mm upstream and the common bile duct is dilated to 14 mm. The lymph node stations are dissected separately and submitted in labelled cassettes. Representative sections are taken; see block key.

(1-4) Tumour with posterior surface.
(5) Pancreatic neck margin, en face.
(6) Bile duct margin, en face.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple resection)
- Origin: Pancreatic (ductal adenocarcinoma centred in the pancreatic head or
  uncinate process)
- Tumour site: Head of pancreas
- Tumour size: 1.4 cm (unifocal invasive carcinoma, greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Ductal adenocarcinoma, NOS
- Histologic grade: G2, moderately differentiated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a moderately differentiated ductal adenocarcinoma, NOS, confined
  to the pancreas. Haphazardly arranged infiltrating glands with incomplete
  lumina and luminal necrotic debris are set in abundant desmoplastic stroma,
  lying immediately adjacent to muscular vessels and nerves, and show marked
  variation in nuclear size within individual glands. The tumour cells express
  CK7. There is loss of nuclear SMAD4 (DPC4) expression.
- Sites involved by direct extension: Confined to pancreas
- Pancreatic surface involvement: Not identified
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Treatment effect: Present, with residual cancer showing evident tumour
  regression but more than single cells or rare small groups of cancer cells
  (partial response, score 2)
- Precursor lesion: Pancreatic intraepithelial neoplasia, high grade (PanIN)

Margins
- Pancreatic neck (transection) margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 8 mm
- Bile duct margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 12 mm
- Uncinate (retroperitoneal / superior mesenteric artery) margin: Uninvolved by
  invasive carcinoma, 6 mm
- Posterior surface: Involved by invasive carcinoma
- Proximal (gastric or duodenal) margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 45 mm
- Distal (duodenal or jejunal) margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 60 mm
- High-grade dysplasia at the margins: Not identified

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 16 examined; 0 involved
  - Number examined: 16
  - Number involved: 0

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not identified

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: ypT1c ypN0
  - Stage group (if cM0): IA

Additional findings
- Chronic pancreatitis

PANCREAS AND DUODENUM, head of pancreas, pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple
resection)
- DUCTAL ADENOCARCINOMA, NOS, moderately differentiated, 1.4 cm, confined to the
  pancreas; treatment effect: present, with residual cancer showing evident
  tumour regression but more than single cells or rare small groups of cancer
  cells (partial response, score 2); posterior surface involved; remaining
  margins clear (closest 6 mm); see synoptic report
- 0 of 16 regional lymph nodes involved
- ypT1c ypN0 (AJCC 8th edition), stage IA (if cM0)
